purpose: functional verification of machine disk snapshots on KVM; no timing claim

cases.name: a snapshot of a running machine is refused

detail.refused: machine snapped-01 is running; stop it to take a snapshot, so its disk is not half-written

cases.name: stopped, a snapshot is taken and listed, with what it holds on the node
restoring a snapshot undoes what changed since
restoring the later snapshot brings it back; each snapshot is its own
a downloaded disk is a clean filesystem holding the files as they were
a snapshot taken before a resize restores the smaller disk
what cannot be done is refused; deletes remove snapshots and the machine its own
